subject: website
name: Domains.UBNET
summary: The UBNet name registration page. No public source was found for the code it runs. It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads the UBNet SDK, about 26 scripts from my.eth-ub.net with no integrity hash, third-party code the user has not asked for that the host can change at any time. It also loads Google Fonts and reads chain data from publicnode.
